findings.if_skipped: An invalid authored permission request silently changes the requested operation into PNG export; apply can publish that artifact instead of refusing.
findings.problem: Raw resource validation only executes when the final decoded profile.Render pointer is nonnil. The JSON decoder accepts duplicate root render keys and later null discards the earlier object. As a result the new resource/null/path checks are skipped and a successful export report is published.
findings.smallest_fix: Use the existing checkJSON on root render ownership/duplicates before field-map or decoded-pointer decisions, and inspect raw render permission alias/null keys independently of the final Render pointer. Extend the existing CLI table with shadow/null/alias cases, including apply output absence. No new helper is needed.
